sql.participants-load: SELECT ac.name AS agent, dp.status, dp.role FROM discussion_participants dp JOIN actors ac ON ac.id = dp.actor_id WHERE dp.discussion_id = $1
sql.discussion-history: SELECT DISTINCT ON (cmt.id) cmt.id, fa.name AS from_agent, cmt.message, cmt.sent_at FROM chat_message_texts cmt JOIN actors fa ON fa.id = cmt.from_actor_id WHERE cmt.discussion_id = $1 AND NOT (fa.name = 'system') AND NOT cmt.is_error ORDER BY cmt.id DESC LIMIT $2
sql.vote-question: SELECT question FROM discussion_votes WHERE id = $1
sql.ballot-check: SELECT 1 FROM discussion_ballots WHERE vote_id = $1 AND actor_id = $2
sql.ballot-insert: INSERT INTO discussion_ballots (vote_id, actor_id, choice, reason) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
